# 🪪 AGR-096 · `performance-cycle-summarizer`

> Aggregate self, peer and manager input into a calibrated summary with evidence for every claim.

Legend: `[/…/]` router · `{{…}}` verifier · `[…]` worker/agent node.

## What it does

Aggregate peer feedback into balanced review drafts.

## Why it should deliver results

Staged specialists each own one narrow concern, so quality problems are localized to the stage that produced them instead of being smeared across a single mega-prompt. Output only leaves the graph through the exit contract.

- **Exit contract** — every statement cites an input and no bias flag survives calibration
- **Machine-checked** — `output.uncited_claims == 0`
- **Machine-checked** — `len(output.bias_flags) == 0`
- **Bounded** — hard stop after 25 steps; every loop edge is condition-guarded
- **Golden cases** — `uv run agr eval performance-cycle-summarizer` replays recorded cases through the real edge/assert logic (mock runner proves mechanics; `--live` measures your model)
- **Trace gallery** — [every case's route, node outputs, and checked asserts](../../../docs/traces/performance-cycle-summarizer.md)

## How to work with it

```bash
uv run agr show performance-cycle-summarizer       # full definition
uv run agr profile performance-cycle-summarizer    # deterministic structural facts
uv run agr mermaid performance-cycle-summarizer    # regenerate the diagram below
uv run agr eval performance-cycle-summarizer       # run golden cases (add --live for your endpoint)
uv run agr adapt performance-cycle-summarizer --target langgraph > app.py   # compile to runnable LangGraph
uv run agr optimize performance-cycle-summarizer   # propose bounded structural improvements (dry-run)
```

Over MCP: `uv run agr mcp` exposes the registry (search / show / profile) to any MCP client.
To evolve it: `uv run agr infuse performance-cycle-summarizer <node> <ability>` — every mutation is gate-checked and appended to the graph's lineage log.

## Node roster

| Node | Speciality | Kind | Abilities |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gather` | mapper | agent | map_shard |
| `synthesize` | reducer | agent | reduce_merge |
| `bias-check` | critic | agent | critique |
| `calibrate` | judge | verifier | adjudicate |

## Edge logic

| From | To | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| `gather` | `synthesize` | always |
| `synthesize` | `bias-check` | always |
| `bias-check` | `synthesize` | len(bias_flags) > 0 and attempts < 2 |
| `bias-check` | `calibrate` | len(bias_flags) == 0 |

## Optional use-cases

Adjacent entries from the use-case catalog this card adapts to with small edits:

- **interview-question-bank** (hr-people, generator-critic) — Generate role questions, critic checks legality and signal. *Verify:* no prohibited-topic questions; rubric attached.
- **engagement-survey-analysis** (hr-people, map-reduce) — Theme open-text responses, reduce with anonymity floor. *Verify:* themes cite response counts; k-anonymity respected.

- **training-gap-analyzer** (hr-people, map-reduce) — Map skills against role matrix, reduce to training plan. *Verify:* gaps reference assessment evidence.
- **cloud-cost-optimizer** (devops-sre, pipeline) — Scan usage, propose rightsizing, verify against SLO headroom. *Verify:* projected savings computed from real billing export.
